title: If the Bible is true…
paragraphs:
If the Bible is true…
ignoring God is the most dangerous decision a person can make.

Not rejecting Him.
Not mocking Him.
Because one day, every person will stand before God.

Most people don’t hate God.
They just ignore Him.
But if the Bible is true…
that might be the most dangerous decision a person can make.
Do you think that’s more dangerous? 👀
